div.div: ثَوْبٌ ضَافٍ A garment that is complete, full, ample, or without deficiency. (S, Msb, K. *) And فَرَسٌ ضَافِى السَّبِيب A horse full, or ample, in the سبيب [or hair of the forelock or of the mane or of the tail]. (TA.) And رَجُلٌ ضَافِى الرَّأْسِ A man having much hair of the head. (S.) And دِيمّةٌ ضَافيَةٌ A lasting, or continuous, or continuous and still, rain, in consequence of which the land becomes abundant with herbage. (TA.) And هُوَ ضَافِى الفَضْلِ (tropical:) [He is abundant in excellence]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
